title_en: When Things Don't Go as Planned
title_cn: 当事情不按计划进行时
content_en: Last Saturday, I planned to spend the day at the beach. I packed my bag, prepared some food, and left home early. However, dark clouds appeared while I was on the bus. Soon, heavy rain began, and the beach trip was no longer possible. At first, I felt disappointed because I had been looking forward to it all week. Then I remembered a small art museum near the bus station. I decided to visit it instead. The museum was quiet and interesting, and I discovered several paintings I really liked. That evening, I realized that a change of plan could still lead to a good day.
content_cn: 上周六，我计划去海边度过一天。我收拾好包，准备了一些食物，然后很早就离开了家。然而，我在公交车上时，天空出现了乌云。很快，大雨开始下起来，海滩之行也无法继续了。起初，我感到很失望，因为我整整期待了一周。后来，我想起了公交车站附近的一家小型艺术博物馆。我决定改去那里参观。博物馆很安静，也很有意思，我发现了几幅自己非常喜欢的画作。那天晚上，我意识到，计划改变了，仍然可能迎来美好的一天。

sentences.explanation: plan to do something 表示计划做某事，后面接动词原形。

title_cn: 一位陌生人给我的启示
content_en: One afternoon, I was waiting for a train when an old man sat beside me. He noticed that I was looking at my phone again and again. He smiled and asked if I was waiting for important news. I told him that I was worried about a job interview. He listened quietly and then shared a story about his first job. He said he had made many mistakes, but each one had taught him something useful. His words helped me feel calmer. When my train arrived, I thanked him. I never learned his name, but I still remember his simple advice: keep trying and learn along the way.
content_cn: 一天下午，我正在等火车，一位老人坐到了我旁边。他注意到我一次又一次地看手机。他微笑着问我是不是在等重要消息。我告诉他，我正在为一场工作面试感到担忧。他安静地听着，然后分享了自己第一份工作的故事。他说自己犯过很多错误，但每一次错误都教会了他一些有用的东西。他的话让我平静了许多。火车到站时，我向他道了谢。我始终不知道他的名字，但我一直记得他那句简单的建议：继续尝试，并在过程中学习。

content_en: I used to avoid speaking in front of other people. Even in small meetings, I stayed quiet because I was afraid of making mistakes. One day, my team needed someone to explain a new idea. Nobody volunteered, so I took a deep breath and raised my hand. My voice was not very strong, and I forgot one important point. However, my coworkers listened and asked useful questions. After the meeting, my manager thanked me for trying. I felt proud, not because I was perfect, but because I had taken the first step. Since then, speaking up has become a little easier.
content_cn: 我过去常常避免在别人面前讲话。即使是在小型会议上，我也保持沉默，因为我害怕犯错。一天，我们团队需要有人解释一个新想法。没有人主动报名，于是我深吸一口气，举起了手。我的声音不太响亮，而且忘记了一个重要的要点。然而，同事们认真倾听，还提出了一些有用的问题。会议结束后，经理感谢我愿意尝试。我感到自豪，并不是因为自己表现得完美，而是因为我迈出了第一步。从那以后，主动表达自己的想法变得容易了一些。

title_en: How I Changed Over the Years
title_cn: 这些年来我是如何改变的
content_en: When I was younger, I wanted everything to happen quickly. I often became upset when things did not go my way. I also cared too much about what other people thought of me. Over the years, my experiences have slowly changed the way I see life. I have learned to be more patient and to accept that I cannot control everything. I now spend more time on things that truly matter, such as my health, family, and personal goals. I still make mistakes, but I do not judge myself as harshly as before. Growing older has not made me perfect, but it has helped me understand myself better.
content_cn: 年轻时，我希望所有事情都能迅速发生。当事情不如我意时，我常常会感到烦恼。我也过于在意别人对我的看法。这些年来，我的经历慢慢改变了我看待生活的方式。我学会了更加耐心，也学会接受自己无法控制所有事情。现在，我会把更多时间花在真正重要的事情上，比如健康、家庭和个人目标。我仍然会犯错，但不会像以前那样严厉地批评自己。年龄增长并没有让我变得完美，却帮助我更好地了解自己。

title_en: The Best Advice I Ever Received
title_cn: 我曾收到过的最好建议
content_en: A few years ago, I was unhappy with my progress at work. I compared myself with others and felt that I was falling behind. One day, my father noticed my mood and asked what was wrong. After listening to me, he said, "Don't compare your beginning with someone else's middle." At first, I did not fully understand his words. Later, I realized that everyone has a different path and moves at a different speed. Since then, I have focused more on my own goals. I still look at what others achieve, but I use it for inspiration instead of pressure. That advice has helped me become more confident.
content_cn: 几年前，我对自己在工作上的进步感到不满意。我总是拿自己和别人比较，觉得自己落在了后面。一天，父亲注意到了我的情绪，便问我出了什么事。听我说完后，他说：“不要拿自己的起点和别人的中途相比。”起初，我并没有完全理解他的话。后来，我意识到每个人都有不同的人生道路，前进的速度也不一样。从那以后，我更加专注于自己的目标。我仍然会关注别人的成就，但我把它们当作激励，而不是压力。这条建议帮助我变得更加自信。

content_en: Christmas is one of the most popular holidays in many countries. In December, streets and stores are often decorated with lights, trees, and colorful signs. Families may put up a Christmas tree at home and place gifts under it. On Christmas Eve, some people attend church, while others enjoy dinner with their families. Children often look forward to opening their presents the next morning. Food is also an important part of the celebration. People may share roasted meat, cookies, and other special dishes. Although traditions are different from place to place, Christmas is often a time for kindness, family, and sharing.
content_cn: 圣诞节是许多国家最受欢迎的节日之一。到了十二月，街道和商店通常会用灯饰、圣诞树和彩色标志装饰起来。许多家庭会在家里摆放圣诞树，并把礼物放在树下。平安夜时，一些人会去教堂，而另一些人则和家人共进晚餐。孩子们通常期待第二天早上打开礼物。食物也是庆祝活动的重要组成部分。人们可能会分享烤肉、饼干和其他特色菜肴。虽然不同地方的传统有所不同，但圣诞节通常是一个充满善意、家庭温情和分享的时刻。

sentences.sentence_en: Christmas is one of the most popular holidays in many countries.

sentences.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 名词复数，表示最……的……之一。

content_en: Chinese New Year is an important festival for many families. Before the holiday, people clean their homes to welcome a fresh start. Red decorations are placed on doors and windows because red is a symbol of good luck. Many people travel to their hometowns to spend time with relatives. On New Year's Eve, families often enjoy a large dinner together. Children may receive red envelopes with money inside. During the holiday, people visit relatives, share food, and exchange good wishes. Fireworks are also part of the celebration in some places. For many people, the most meaningful part is not the decorations or gifts, but being together with family.
content_cn: 春节对许多家庭来说是一个重要的节日。节日前，人们会打扫房屋，迎接一个新的开始。红色装饰品会被贴在门窗上，因为红色象征着好运。许多人会回到家乡，与亲人团聚。除夕夜，家人通常会一起享用丰盛的晚餐。孩子们可能会收到装有钱的红包。春节期间，人们走亲访友、分享食物，并互相送上美好的祝福。在一些地方，烟花也是庆祝活动的一部分。对许多人来说，最有意义的并不是装饰或礼物，而是与家人团聚。

content_en: Birthdays are special days for people of all ages. Some families celebrate at home with a cake, candles, and a homemade meal. Others invite friends to a restaurant or plan an outdoor activity. At a birthday party, guests often sing a song and give presents to the person being celebrated. In some places, people make a wish before blowing out the candles. Not everyone enjoys a big party, though. Some people prefer a quiet dinner or a simple phone call from someone they love. No matter how people celebrate, a birthday can be a chance to feel remembered and appreciated by others.
content_cn: 生日对各个年龄段的人来说都是特别的日子。一些家庭会在家里用蛋糕、蜡烛和自制餐食来庆祝。另一些人则邀请朋友去餐厅，或者安排户外活动。在生日聚会上，客人们通常会唱生日歌，并向过生日的人赠送礼物。在一些地方，人们会在吹灭蜡烛前许个愿。不过，并不是每个人都喜欢大型派对。有些人更喜欢安静地吃顿晚餐，或者接到心爱之人的一个简单电话。无论人们如何庆祝，生日都可以成为一个感受到他人惦记和珍惜的机会。

content_en: When people visit another country, they may notice customs that are different from their own. In some cultures, people take off their shoes before entering a home. In others, guests may bring a small gift when visiting someone. The way people greet each other can also be different. Some shake hands, while others bow or hug. Even eating habits can vary. In one place, people may eat with chopsticks, while in another, they use forks and knives. These differences can seem surprising at first. However, learning about local customs helps travelers show respect and avoid misunderstandings. Being curious and open-minded makes meeting new cultures more enjoyable.
content_cn: 当人们访问另一个国家时，可能会注意到一些与自己国家不同的习俗。在某些文化中，人们进屋前会脱鞋。在另一些地方，客人拜访别人时可能会带一份小礼物。人们互相问候的方式也可能不同。有些人握手，有些人鞠躬或拥抱。甚至饮食习惯也会有所不同。在一个地方，人们可能用筷子吃饭，而在另一个地方，人们使用叉子和刀。这些差异起初可能让人感到惊讶。然而，了解当地习俗有助于旅行者表达尊重，并避免误解。保持好奇和开放的心态，会让接触新文化变得更加愉快。

content_en: Everyone has stories worth sharing, even if their lives seem ordinary. I used to think that my experiences were not interesting enough to talk about. However, a friend once asked me to share a memory from childhood. I told him about a summer when I learned to ride a bicycle. I fell many times, but my grandfather encouraged me to try again. My friend enjoyed the story and shared one of his own. That conversation reminded me that small moments can mean a lot. Since then, I have become more willing to talk about my past. Sharing stories helps people understand each other and feel closer.
content_cn: 每个人都有值得分享的故事，即使他们的生活看起来很普通。我过去常常认为自己的经历不够有趣，不值得讲出来。然而，有一次，一位朋友请我分享一段童年回忆。我给他讲了自己在一个夏天学骑自行车的经历。我摔倒过很多次，但祖父一直鼓励我再试一次。朋友很喜欢这个故事，也分享了他自己的故事。这次交谈让我想起，小小的瞬间也可能意义重大。从那以后，我变得更愿意谈论自己的过去。分享故事能帮助人们相互理解，并让彼此的关系更加亲近。
